notes: Summary of changes discussed/applied in this workspace, including items later undone.

updates.title: Results page uses live /results API
updates.description: Replaced mock results on ResultsPage with live API fetch so counts match HomePage.

updates.title: Registration persistence expiration
updates.description: Added and then removed a registration expiration concept to allow re-registration after a time window.

updates.title: Voter ID recovery on re-registration
updates.description: Updated /register to return existing voter_id for the same identity if not voted.

updates.title: Liveness verification gate UI
updates.description: Added a simulated verification modal (camera prompt + steps) before registration in the frontend.

updates.title: Face verification integration (face-api.js)
updates.description: Integrated face-api.js in the frontend and added face embedding handling and matching logic in the backend.

updates.title: Model loading and camera handling fixes
updates.description: Added secure context checks, model loading safeguards, timeouts, and optional CDN model paths for face verification.

updates.title: Verification modal sizing
updates.description: Adjusted verification modal sizing to fit within the viewport using a dedicated CSS class.

updates.title: Root README created
updates.description: Generated a project README documenting architecture, features, setup, and endpoints.
